title: Rooms Blobs — Get — payload
description: Open a download of one blob committed in a data room: the host returns its ciphertext manifest and either a time-limited storage URL for the object (direct) or a handle for fetching its chunks through the host (proxied). The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

roomId.description: The room the blob belongs to. The host verifies the presentation against credentials this identifier issued.

presentation.description: Must confer the `read` action at this room's scope. Its leaf's subject must be the party the host authenticated for this request.

blobRef.description: The blob to fetch, as the record's `blobs` member names it.

direct.description: True when the producer accepts a storage URL for the object. Absent or false: the host answers in proxied mode.

mode.description: `direct`: fetch the object over `target`. `proxied`: fetch its chunks with rooms/blobs/chunk under `downloadId`.

manifest.description: The ciphertext manifest committed at upload. A reader MUST check that its digest equals the requested BlobRef before relying on it, and every chunk against it on arrival.

downloadId.description: Proxied mode only: the download handle for rooms/blobs/chunk. Absent in direct mode.

target.description: Direct mode only: a GET for the one object holding this blob, expiring within minutes. Ranged requests MAY be permitted. Absent in proxied mode.

expiresAt.description: When the handle (proxied) or the target (direct) stops being honoured.
